build.fast_path: Fast path: Forged Dwarf Star (or Stringmaster / Cosmic Ripples) + 5-piece Chromatic Foam (Fusion Burst) or Pact of Neonlight Leap (Tune Strain) in a 4-3-3-1-1 layout. Aim for a Crit 4-cost, Fusion DMG 3-costs, ATK% 1-costs, and 125% Energy Regen.

pull_verdict.source_guide: research: community build sources (no site pull guide exists)
pull_verdict.verdict: One of the most valuable sub-DPS units in the game; enables both the Fusion Burst and Tune Strain compositions and frees Lynae up for other teams. SS overall on the 3.7 tier list — a top pull for any roster running status or Tune Strain carries.
